patches.title: Grab Visible Target on Sight
patches.principle: If the target object is visible on the current surface, take it immediately. Do not navigate to another furniture piece first.
patches.when_to_apply: When you arrive at a surface and see the target object.

patches.title: Pick Only Exact Name Match
patches.principle: Only pick up objects whose name exactly matches the task description. If you pick the wrong one, put it back immediately.
patches.when_to_apply: When you are about to take an object that may not be the task target.

patches.title: Stay and Examine After Light
patches.principle: After turning on a lamp, thoroughly examine the same surface and nearby surfaces before moving to distant locations.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have just activated a lamp in a look_at_obj_in_light task.
